definition: Processing.js was a JavaScript implementation for running Processing-style graphics programs in a web browser.
entry_text: Processing.js was a JavaScript implementation for running Processing-style graphics programs in a web browser.
example: An artist used it to display an interactive drawing on a webpage.
label: Processing.js
sense_note: Distinguish it from the Processing desktop environment and p5.js.

sources.note: The original repository describes the JavaScript port of the Processing visualization language and marks it archived since 2018. It is distinct from p5.js.
